implementation_disposition.closure_boundary: The implementation closeout is archived; ongoing effectiveness is evaluated longitudinally instead of treated as present-tense implementation proof.

future_evidence_audit.remaining_gap: A full current audit of other future-evidence-blocked open issues must be produced by an Evaluation owner operation before any closure or migration claim.
future_evidence_audit.classification_rule: Present implementation proof remains in closeout records; recurring or delayed effectiveness evidence is collected through the Evaluation lifecycle and must not be used as a closure shortcut.
